meta.shared_style: STYLE: ink and watercolour on aged parchment. Loose confident pen line, wet bleeding washes with visible grain and hard edges where the water dried. Palette: raw sienna, burnt umber, ochre, warm grey, with sparing indigo and a single warm gold accent. Muted, aged, hand-made. Generous empty parchment. Cinematic 16:9, 1920x1080.
